Ana (CS): Hey team — Adapt Health asked for a multi-week enablement series for their migration: week 1 = intro + async prework, week 2 = deep-dive (model tuning, routing), week 3 = go-live runbook + smoke tests. They have users in US/EMEA/APAC and want APAC interpretation for mornings. Can we propose a cadence and facilitator rota?

Mike (Enablement): TL;DR — I can run weeks 1 & 2 content if someone else takes week 3 go-live runbook. For APAC interpretation we can do simultaneous captions + a dedicated interpreter on week 2.

Jamie (Product): Quick Q — do they need a dedicated migration clinic for data mapping, or is the deep-dive enough? If dedicated, we should reserve a 90min slot and an engineer.

Luis (Adapt - PM): Prefer a migration clinic separate from deep-dive. Their infra lead needs an engineering Q/A window. APAC folks prefer 9–11am SGT. EU prefers afternoons UTC+1. US flexible mornings PT.

Sam (CS Ops): Ok — propose this draft schedule (times are local windows):
```
Week 1: Onboard + prework review — 60m
  US: Wed 10am PT / EU: Wed 18:00 CET / APAC: Thu 09:00 SGT (recorded)
Week 2: Deep-dive + migration clinic — 120m (first 60m deep-dive; last 60m clinic)
  US: Tue 10am PT / EU: Tue 18:00 CET / APAC: Wed 09:00 SGT (live interpreter)
Week 3: Go-live runbook + smoke test walkthrough — 90m
  US: Thu 9am PT / EU: Thu 17:00 CET / APAC: Fri 09:30 SGT
```
I can spin up calendar placeholders and include timezone-specific links.

Ana (CS): That looks good. Two operational asks: 1) we need one engineer for the migration clinic (Jamie can confirm), 2) a 1-pager prework checklist to send to the customer. I'll draft both.

Jamie (Product): I can cover the engineer slot for week 2 clinic (90m block) — will prep a short checklist of infra hooks they should have. Also will join week 3 runbook for smoke test checklist.

Mike (Enablement): I'll prepare slide deck + lab exercises for week 2. For APAC interpreter, do we have vendor contacts? If not, I can request our translation partner.

Ana (CS): @Luis — can you confirm the list of attendees and whether we should invite their security reviewer to week 3? Also, any blackout dates in the next 6 weeks?

Luis (Adapt - PM): Attendees: product, infra lead, security reviewer (tentative), two devs for POC. No blackout dates the next 6 weeks but they have sprint freezes on calendar weeks 33–34 (avoid those). Security reviewer prefers a separate 30m sync if needed.

Sam (CS Ops): Action items:
- Ana: draft prework checklist + send to Luis by EOD Wed
- Mike: slide deck + labs for week 2 by next Tue
- Jamie: engineer prep + infra hooks doc by next Tue
- Sam: create calendar invites with timezone variants and add `Interpreter: TBD` tag
- Luis: confirm final attendee list + whether security sync is required by Fri

scheduler-bot: Poll created — https://doodle.example/Adapt-Enablement (please add availability).

Ana (CS): Nice. One more thing — let's limit lab exercises to 30m per attendee to keep things interactive. Also adding a shared repo with sample prompts and a `prework/` folder. I'll make that repo and share link in the invites. :party_parrot:

Luis (Adapt - PM): Thanks everyone — I'll fill out the poll today and confirm attendees by Friday. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Mike (Enablement): @Sam can you book a meeting room for our internal dry-run the day before week 2? 60m should do.

Sam (CS Ops): Yup — booking now and will post calendar.

Ana (CS): Great — I'll send a thread update once invites are live and the prework doc is up. Closing loop: deliverables due next Tue except prework (EOD Wed).

Ana (CS): (added emoji reactions) :white_check_mark: :raised_hands:
